# Atkinson Hyperlegible, vendored

The Dashboard's text face, shipped beside the engine so the page never fetches a font from a network
(invariant 7). A web asset, not a Python dependency. The same three files serve the website.

| | |
|---|---|
| Package | `atkinson-hyperlegible` (Google Fonts' repository of the Braille Institute's font) |
| Version | 1.393 (the files' own version) |
| Home | https://github.com/googlefonts/atkinson-hyperlegible |
| Source | `fonts/webfonts/` and `OFL.txt` at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/googlefonts/atkinson-hyperlegible/main/ |
| Files taken | `AtkinsonHyperlegible-Regular.woff2`, `-Italic.woff2`, `-Bold.woff2`, unmodified |
